atomicMutationRequires: proven mismatch in retained stage inputs
transactionalStateValidation.missingOrMalformedStatePolicy: fail without creating or rewriting state

stageCommandResult.framingPolicy: exactly one frame; final non-empty stdout record; complete canonical single-line JSON; earlier unframed JSON is log data; malformed, missing, competing, or trailing records fail
stageCommandResult.orderingProof: the wrapper awaits every synchronous or asynchronous stage owner, inherited child streams close before return, durable evidence/state publication completes first, and failure cleanup completes before the one terminal frame is written
semanticValidation: physical state SHA and canonical state validation
complete referenced evidence inventory and independent file rehash
producer-side privacy validation and redacted/resealed validation reports
stageCommandResult.logs: complete stdout and stderr remain diagnostic logs and never become semantic JSON authority
stageCommandResult.privateDataPolicy: no raw database URL/password, credential, secret, cookie/session, private environment, state path, or unrestricted machine-private path
stageCommandResult.authResultChannel: unchanged structured auth sidecars plus private GITHUB_ENV raw assignments
stageCommandResult.databasePlanResultChannel: unchanged complete canonical stdout JSON document
stageCommandResult.archiveChildParser: unchanged and prohibited for certification stage-wrapper framing

databaseLifecycle.namePolicy: fixed lowercase interior_ai_gate_a3_test_cert_ prefix plus a 32-hex SHA-256 prefix bound to certification ID, candidate ID, candidate commit, disposable classification, and owner-generated 128-bit nonce; maximum 63 bytes; no caller-selected final name
databaseLifecycle.serverPolicy: explicit 127.0.0.1 or ::1, port 5432, postgres admin database, PostgreSQL 14 or newer, createdb or local-superuser role
databaseLifecycle.absencePolicy: plan is database-non-mutating and provision repeats absence just in time; an existing target always fails closed and is never reused
databaseLifecycle.migrationPolicy: exact current 43 repository migrations through Prisma migrate deploy, followed by exact target migration-name verification
databaseLifecycle.rowPolicy: catalog-derived public application tables excluding only _prisma_migrations must have zero rows initially and finally; no generic DELETE or leak-hiding cleanup is permitted
databaseLifecycle.sessionPolicy: inventory exact target sessions; normal final verification requires zero; normal/abort cleanup may terminate only exact target sessions while excluding the admin session
databaseLifecycle.dropPolicy: drop only the generated owned target after exact session release and prove catalog absence; no server restart or broad process termination
databaseLifecycle.abortPolicy: retain original failure and consumed status, capture rows/sessions, never fabricate final-empty PASS, drop the disposable target, prove absence, and never rehabilitate the failed run
databaseLifecycle.stageProjectionPolicy: provision a lifecycle-scoped NOSUPERUSER/NOCREATEDB/NOCREATEROLE stage login; retain its raw target only in a mode-0600 private worktree-root sidecar whose hash is sealed into lifecycle evidence; require the exact live target/non-admin role before stage binding; reject ambient override, stale/foreign/dropped identity, missing readiness, sidecar tamper, or missing stage binding; expose raw target only to the declared database-capable stage projector and redact any child stdout/stderr occurrence
databaseLifecycle.portableEvidencePolicy: retain safe database name/hash, policy/generator/owner hashes, server and role classifications, event/inventory/session/drop/absence results, timestamps, aggregate SHA-256 and seal; never retain passwords or raw URLs

requiredRoles.final-artifact: dependency install, build, archive, Phase 8, runtime smoke, final standalone, and continuity
requiredRoles.development-browser: cart and retailer development-server browser owners

stageWorktrees.creation: three fresh stage-owned detached Git worktrees at the exact candidate commit and tree
stageWorktrees.canonicalIgnoredArtifactPolicy: non-influential, uninspected by stage owners, and byte-for-byte untouched
stageWorktrees.privateBindingPolicy: physical paths and hashes are retained only in private evidence-root sidecars
stageWorktrees.cleanupPolicy: explicit cleanup owner after continuity or terminal abort; remove only task-owned roots

dependencyLifecycle.bindingOwner: certification harness under the exclusive state lock

final-artifact: next-env.d.ts no-follow inventory and exact cleanup

dependencyLifecycle.alreadyBoundPolicy: same identity may be revalidated read-only; a different identity cannot overwrite state
dependencyLifecycle.driftPolicy: hash installed implementation bytes; fail the current stage and invalidate dependent stages without reinstall or refresh
dependencyLifecycle.installationEnvironmentPolicy: minimal allowlist with no certification controls, credentials, NODE_PATH, NODE_OPTIONS, global or user npm configuration, or raw environment evidence
dependencyLifecycle.resolutionPolicy: physical role-local node_modules only; reject root symlinks, external dependency symlinks, cross-worktree resolution, NODE_PATH, and global resolution

buildGeneratedOutputLifecycle.preProducerPolicy: the literal ignored and untracked path must have no filesystem entry before Next build dispatch
buildGeneratedOutputLifecycle.postProducerPolicy: the literal path must be a no-follow physical regular file with the exact current production type-declaration bytes and SHA-256
buildGeneratedOutputLifecycle.retentionBoundary: retain through production artifact and journal validation within the build command
buildGeneratedOutputLifecycle.cleanupPolicy: unlink only the literal hash-validated file and prove no filesystem entry remains before dependency revalidation, the immediate artifact snapshot, and managed-stage post-action worktree validation
buildGeneratedOutputLifecycle.failurePolicy: preexisting output is non-consuming precondition failure; missing, substituted, symlinked, non-file, or byte-mismatched producer output is consumed artifact-continuity failure

runtimeSmokeEvidenceRoot.diagnosticsPolicy: readiness, post-readiness, browser, and failure diagnostics are embedded report/timing content; safe stdout/stderr and server logs are non-portable parent streams
pathPolicy: outside every repository and stage worktree

scopes.executableArchiveClosure: complete production archive inventory excluding only its self-describing inventory file
